name: Cloudgate Booking
description: A branded appointment booking site and studio back office: services, staff, rooms, availability, full payments or deposits, cancellations, refunds, client records and reminders.
features: Service discovery with search, category filters and a responsive photo-led design
Customer login and signup, saved contact details, appointment history and secure guest-booking claims
Custom app name, logo, icon, favicon and theme colours with image uploads and live preview
Front-desk reservations for existing or new clients with private payment links and safe recovery
Weekly calendar and server-verified promotion, deposit and balance quotes
Multi-service booking with qualified therapists, room availability and cleanup buffers
Full payments or deposits through Cloudgate Wallet; confirmation after verified payment
Self-service rescheduling, cancellation, booking access links and calendar downloads
Back office calendar, clients, staff hours, resources, waitlist, promotions and reports
Email outbox and scheduled reminders; payment recovery and protected refunds

summary: Payments are processed through your Cloudgate Wallet.
